title: ExploitHunter
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 editorial blog hero, 1600x900 composition. Create a bold sophisticated investigative PHOTOMONTAGE made from cut photographic paper and ink, as if commissioned by an independent literary/security journal, NOT a miniature architectural model or a studio product photo. Article idea: a security agent's confident claim means little without preserved evidence and a bounded human investigation. On a deep carbon-black inked ground, a monumental silver photographic magnifying glass dominates the center-right, its lens held over one vermilion-red torn paper seam in an otherwise charcoal photographic surface. Inside the lens the seam reveals sharply legible underlying paper fibers and a small silver photographic metal fragment, while outside the lens the seam remains ambiguous. A restrained cluster of ripped gray photocopy fragments beneath it suggests accumulated evidence; the fragments have only analog toner grain, opaque black redaction bars and abstract physical impressions, absolutely no readable letters, code, numbers or invented charts. A large cropped monochrome photographic hand holds the magnifier from the left edge, deliberate and human. Rich black lithographic texture, silver halftone photographs, one hot vermilion accent, strong flat asymmetry, torn edges and overlapping shadows, ink-heavy graphic montage, intense but elegant. Full bleed image, no outer frame, no ivory background. The decisive red seam and lens sit in the central 60 percent for shallow crops and thumbnail readability; let the hand be peripheral. No folders, keyed slots, aperture models, gates, trays, robot heads, computers, surveillance eyes, locks, shields, circuitry, fake UI, logos, words, watermark or title typography.
cover_alt: A photographic hand holds a magnifying glass over a vermilion tear in black paper, revealing fibers and a silver fragment above layered monochrome scraps.
cropNote: Shallow 2.25:1 crop retains lens and torn seam; peripheral evidence scraps crop away. Fresh square should simplify around lens and red seam rather than preserve every scrap.
qualityReview: Bold legible lens silhouette at small sizes. Human hand and gritty photocopy residue depart strongly from the earlier mechanical stock models. The scraps are metaphorical collage, not claimed screenshots or captured evidence.
status: New candidate; not selected; existing finals and first batch preserved

title: Semantic Vector Search
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 editorial blog hero, 1600x900 composition. Create a lush sophisticated botanical photographic paper collage for an essay about semantic search: different surface appearances can share underlying meaning; search works by kinship rather than spelling. A single oversized branching botanical silhouette stretches diagonally across the middle: three distinct photographic cut-out leaves with radically different surfaces (a fern frond, a dark broad glossy aubergine leaf, and a pale yellow ginkgo fan) connect to the SAME sinuous paper stem, their bases grouped visibly together, implying related meaning despite different appearances. Around this central cluster, one unrelated geometric black-and-white striped paper shard sits alone at the lower far-right, enough separation to read as a different family rather than a matching slot. Dramatic scale, rich plant photography collaged with flat moss-green and saturated aubergine paper fields, flashes of acidic lemon-yellow cut stock, strong recognizable foliage silhouettes. Full bleed lush vertical organic curves in a wide frame, a little surreal and intellectually playful, sophisticated independent magazine art rather than a diagram or children's craft. Composition is flat frontal photomontage, tactile crisp scissor-cut edges and subtle paper overlap shadows, high contrast between dark botanical photography and lemon negative space. The central plant grouping must read beautifully at thumbnail size; keep its connected bases and principal leaves in the central 60 percent so 2.25:1 crops retain the idea. Let a few leaf tips reach outward, varied density with quieter lemon space at left. This is not photographed miniature machinery. No beige studio, ivory plates, keyed recesses, puzzle shapes, gates, trays, blue-and-rust palette, networks of dots, robots, futuristic imagery, words, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, outer border or title text.
cover_alt: A fern, an aubergine leaf, and a yellow ginkgo fan share one branching stem across torn moss, lemon, and plum paper; a striped triangular scrap sits apart.
cropNote: Shallow crop keeps the contrasting leaves but trims their central joint. For final shallow hero, shift the joint upward or contain the full artwork. Fresh square should gather all three leaf bases centrally; center crop alone loses kinship.
qualityReview: Vivid organic silhouettes and saturated paper fields read immediately at small sizes. Shared stem is an editorial metaphor for related meaning, not a botanical specimen or factual taxonomy.
conceptLanesConsidered: Overlapping botanical silhouettes reveal related patterns
Separated seed families on colored stock
